title: #247 Live Performance
prompt: Attending a live performance, such as a play, is more enjoyable than watching the same event through the internet. Do you agree or disagree?

promptSegments.text: Attending a live performance, such as a play, is more enjoyable than watching the same event through the internet.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Live performances create a unique group feeling that cannot be replicated online.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Live performances create a unique group feeling that cannot be replicated online.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The physical setting and audience interaction improve the quality of the show.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The physical setting and audience interaction improve the quality of the show.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Watching a show live creates a stronger, collective energy in a big hall, which enhances the overall enjoyment of the performance.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Watching a show live creates a stronger, collective energy in a big hall, which enhances the overall enjoyment of the performance.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Live events feel more authentic because the audience and performers share the same physical space, making the performance feel personal and direct.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Live events feel more authentic because the audience and performers share the same physical space, making the performance feel personal and direct.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The main point is that live performances offer a unique, shared atmosphere that digital viewing cannot replicate.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main point is that live performances offer a unique, shared atmosphere that digital viewing cannot replicate.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second point is that live events provide spontaneity and immediate interaction, which enhances the enjoyment.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second point is that live events provide spontaneity and immediate interaction, which enhances the enjoyment.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Live performances offer a unique atmosphere and physical setting that enhances the enjoyment of the event.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Live performances offer a unique atmosphere and physical setting that enhances the enjoyment of the event.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The group setting of a live show allows for shared emotional experiences and a sense of community that online viewing cannot replicate.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The group setting of a live show allows for shared emotional experiences and a sense of community that online viewing cannot replicate.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
